# China Entry Guide

> Accurate, up-to-date English guide to entering and getting set up in China.

Base URL: https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/
Last verified: 2026-11-26

## Pages
- [China Entry Guide — visa-free entry, payments, eSIM & setup](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/): Accurate, up-to-date English guide to entering China: who can enter visa-free (50+ countries), the 240-hour transit policy, paying with foreign cards, eSIMs, rail and checklists.
- [China Visa-Free Entry 2026: 50 Countries, 30 Days](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/visa-free/): Full list of the 50 countries eligible for China single-sided visa-free entry (up to 30 days), the conditions, documents to carry, and what visa-free entry does not allow.
- [China 240-Hour Visa-Free Transit: 57 Countries](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/transit-visa/): How China’s 240-hour visa-free transit works: the 57 eligible countries, the 65 open ports, required connecting tickets, permitted activities and common mistakes.
- [China 240-Hour Transit Ports & Permitted Areas (65 Ports, 24 Regions)](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/transit-ports/): Where you can enter under China’s 240-hour visa-free transit: the 24 permitted provinces/regions, representative open ports by province, and the rules on staying inside the area.
- [Hainan 30-Day Visa-Free Entry: 61 Countries](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/hainan-visa-free/): Hainan’s 30-day visa-free policy for 61 countries: who qualifies, how to enter, where you may stay, and how it compares with the 240-hour transit scheme.
- [Paying in China with Foreign Cards: Alipay & WeChat Pay](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/payment/): How to pay in China as a foreign tourist: linking Visa/Mastercard/UnionPay to Alipay or WeChat Pay, which overseas wallets work, current limits, and backup options.
- [China eSIM & Internet Access for Tourists](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/esim/): The China eSIM guide for tourists: which providers cover mainland China, activation timing, data limits, blocked services (Google, WhatsApp, Instagram) and legal connectivity options.
- [China High-Speed Rail Guide for Foreign Travellers](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/rail/): How to use China’s high-speed rail as a foreign visitor: booking with a passport, 12306 and alternatives, station procedure, and the main Beijing–Shanghai–Guangzhou corridors.
- [Best Time to Visit China: Weather, Crowds & Seasons](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/best-time/): When to visit China by region: spring and autumn weather, typhoon season, Golden Week crowds, and month-by-month guidance for Beijing, Shanghai, Xi’an, Guilin and Hainan.
- [Foreign Card Limits & Fees in China (Alipay / WeChat Pay)](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/payment-limits/): What spending limits and fees apply when you link a foreign card to Alipay or WeChat Pay in China, where the current caps are shown, and how to fix declined payments.
- [First Trip to China: A 7-Day Visa-Free Route (Beijing–Xi’an–Shanghai)](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/first-trip-itinerary/): A practical 7-day first-time China itinerary for visa-free or 240-hour transit visitors: Beijing, Xi’an and Shanghai, with rail legs, entry-path options and booking pointers.
- [China Arrival Checklist — 20 things to do before and after landing](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/checklist/): A practical 20-point China arrival checklist: documents, payments, apps, transport and backup plans — with a progress bar that remembers your place.
- [China Entry FAQ — visa-free, transit, payments, internet](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/faq/): Answers to the most common questions about entering China: who can enter visa-free, how the 240-hour transit works, paying with foreign cards, internet access, rail and timing.
- [China Visa-Free Checker — see if your passport qualifies](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/tools/visa-checker/): Select your passport country to check eligibility for China’s single-sided visa-free entry (50 countries), Hainan 30-day visa-free and the 240-hour transit policy.
- [China 240-Hour Transit Eligibility Checker](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/tools/transit-checker/): Check whether your itinerary likely qualifies for China’s 240-hour visa-free transit: nationality, origin/destination difference and stay length.
- [Beijing for First-Time Visitors: What to Plan and How to Get There](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/beijing/): A practical first-timer guide to Beijing: the Forbidden City, Great Wall sections, hutongs and parks, plus how to arrive, get around and book sites with a foreign passport.
- [Shanghai for First-Time Visitors: Bund, French Concession & Day Trips](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/shanghai/): A first-timer guide to Shanghai: the Bund, French Concession, Yu Garden and museum circuit, plus arrival airports, metro use and practical planning notes.
- [Xi'an for First-Time Visitors: Terracotta Army, City Wall & Muslim Quarter](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/xian/): A first-timer guide to Xi'an: Terracotta Army logistics, the Ming city wall, the Muslim Quarter food circuit, and arrival by air or high-speed rail.
- [About China Entry Guide](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/about/): Who runs China Entry Guide, how we verify policy information, how we make money, and how to contact us.
- [Privacy Policy — China Entry Guide](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/legal/privacy/): What data China Entry Guide collects (and what it does not), how cookies and analytics are used, and your choices.
- [Terms of Use & Affiliate Disclosure — China Entry Guide](https://zendyxxx.github.io/china-entry-guide/legal/terms/): The terms governing use of China Entry Guide, our affiliate disclosure, limitation of liability and the map/compliance notes.
